fullPassage: Sam had always dreamed of becoming a musical actor, and today was his big chance — a life-changing audition. He had practiced endlessly and was perfectly ready. He couldn’t even think of not getting the role. When his name was called, Sam stepped onto the stage, with his head held high and his shoulders held back. The judges’ eyes were fixed on him as he appeared on the stage. But then, without warning, his mind went completely blank. The opening line he had rehearsed so many times didn’t come to him. He opened his mouth, but no sound came out. Frustration started to set in. In the end, Sam couldn’t believe that he couldn’t say a single line.

questions.passage: Sam had always dreamed of becoming a musical actor, and today was his big ①<u>chance</u>. He had practiced endlessly and was perfectly ②<u>ready</u>. He opened his mouth, but no sound came out. ③<u>Frustration</u> started to set in. In the end, Sam couldn’t believe that he ④<u>succeeded in saying</u> a single line.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: Sam은 한 줄도 말하지 못했다(couldn’t say). ④ succeeded in은 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ succeeded in: 원문은 couldn’t say → 실패
✅ ①②③: 원문 일치

det.korean: 머리를 높이(high) 들고 올랐다. ② low는 high의 반의어로 부적절.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 line의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 문맥에서의 의미는 대사이다. 다의어는 문맥에 따라 뜻이 달라진다.

❌ ② 전화선: 다른 문맥에서의 의미
✅ ③ 대사: 이 문맥에서의 적절한 의미
❌ ④ 노선: 다른 문맥에서의 의미
❌ ⑤ 위의 어느 것도 해당하지 않는다.: 다른 문맥에서의 의미
det.tip: 다의어 — 같은 단어도 문맥에 따라 뜻이 달라집니다. 앞뒤 문맥을 꼼꼼히 읽으세요.
